experiment_data.hypothesis: Subsampling power analysis: K*=2 判定在 C4 上所需的最低样本量。在 n={500,1000,2000,3000,4000,5000} 下 10 次 random resample，每次 5-fold CV 计算 1v2 AUC。输出 power curve（K*=2 判定成功率 vs n）。验证类实验，回应 Reviewer 对 statistical power / sample size adequacy 的质疑。
experiment_data.notes: K*=2 detection on C4 requires minimum n=2000 docs for 100% success rate (10/10 resamples). Below n=2000 power drops sharply: n=1000 → 30%, n=500 → 20%. AUC variance monotonically decreases with n (0.018 at n=500 → 0.004 at n=4000). Feature data from exp016_qwen_base (C4, 5000 docs × 6 depths × 15 features). CPU-only, 86s runtime.
